pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: Wrong card. The screen moved on. Undo brings it back.
Every change saves an entry: which card, where it was, where it went.
Undo takes the newest entry and runs it backwards.
History is limited: Office keeps the last hundred actions by default.
Actions that leave the app are harder: [Gmail's](/ʤˈimˌAlz/) Undo Send lasts seconds.
Undo is a short history played in reverse: use it soon, before you hit send.
